The decisive mistake was Chess_Expert's step 7. After the `image_qa` call failed at step 5, Chess_Expert never found another way to read the board. Instead it wrote a hypothetical, made-up position and a placeholder move, "Qd1#". It then asked itself to confirm the position, which got nowhere. At step 8 it ended with TERMINATE and no answer, so the correct move Rd5 was never found.

AGENT: Chess_Expert
STEP: 7
